chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Spain against Croatia, Euro 2024. A loose ball! Cucurella wins it and passes to Rodri. Rodri lays it off to Fabián Ruiz, and first time, Fabián sends Morata through, one against one... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Short, simple passes keep the ball moving. Then Fabián spots a gap between two defenders.

chapters.label: Through the gap
chapters.text: His low pass zips through the gap. Morata runs onto it, and calmly rolls it past the keeper.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball moving with short passes until a gap opens, then pass forward through it.
